# tomswallapi_var (Resource)

A global substitution variable (key/value) usable across the fleet config.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_var" "dns_server" {
  key   = "DNS_SERVER"
  value = "192.0.2.53"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String) Variable value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by key.
terraform import tomswallapi_var.dns_server DNS_SERVER
```
